name: pass-strength-hover-indicator
title: Password Strength Hover
description: A password field with an eye toggle and five strength bars beneath it that fill as rules are met. An info icon beside the label opens a hover card listing each requirement with a tick or cross.
use: A sign-up or account form needs to guide people toward a stronger password as they type.
avoid: Rules live in a hover card only, so touch and keyboard users may not see why a password fails.
a11y: The requirements only appear on hover, and the eye button hides its focus outline. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a dark page, a labelled password input with an eye icon inside its right edge and a small coloured info dot at the top right. Below it run five short rounded segments that turn green as strength rises; an open hover card lists five green-ticked rules.
behaves: Typing fills the bars one by one and recolours the info icon from red through green. Pointing at the icon opens a card that checks each rule live, and the eye button switches the field between hidden dots and plain text.
customise: The five rules and their patterns are a hardcoded array near the top, and the strength texts and colours sit in a config object. The field takes no props.
weight: light: One controlled input, five span bars and a small hover card.
